We audited our three internal portals and counted 14 grays, 6 button styles and 11 font sizes. Tell us what to systematize first, then lay out the scaffolding for a shared system: repo structure, token build, component tiers, and semver releases with changesets.
every app our team ships looks totally different. how do we get one shared system going
